cost_optimization_workshop_notes:
Workshop outcome (2025-01-06): attendees AE Jordan, SE Priya, Infra lead Mateo (Cerise), CFO Alina. Key focuses: batching, cache strategy, quantization profiles, unit economics modeling. Details:
- Batching: recommended dynamic batching window 8-15ms to balance latency and token cost; suggested batch size cap 16 for chat. Identified tail cases (long context) where batching not used.
- Caching: implement prefix KV cache for common onboarding prompts; measured 18-24% token savings on canned flows. Proposed 2-tier cache: route high-frequency customers through cache-enabled nodes.
- Quantization: tested int8/llm.int8 and q4f16 variants in mini-benchmarks. Observed ~2.4x throughput improvement on Dedicated gpus with q4f16 and acceptable quality delta on dev evals. SE cautioned about regen rate on sensitive prompts.
- Unit economics: built sample model comparing Hosted vs Dedicated with commitments. With Dedicated reserved pool + quantization, estimated token unit cost reduction 55-70% depending on cache hit-rate. Break-even at ~650M tokens/month (given their traffic forecast).
- Routing/fallback: plan to route non-critical background jobs to cheaper model variants; live chat stays on low-latency route.
- Actionables: SE to deliver batching config + cache policy template; infra to run 48h Dedicated micro-POC with q4f16; finance to review committed pricing tiers.
